name: Ca cuon thit
summary: Cá cuộn thịt is a fried fish ball stuffed with pork, served with fresh greens, a light fish sauce, and calamansi.
origin: Hanoi, from a stall of some twenty years at an Old Quarter market corner.
howToEat: Fried fish balls stuffed with pork, with fresh greens and a light fish sauce. Squeeze calamansi over them.
seoTitle: Ca cuon thit — Hanoi pork-stuffed fish balls
seoDescription: Cá cuộn thịt in Hanoi is a fried fish ball stuffed with pork, with greens, light fish sauce, and calamansi, at an Old Quarter market corner.
